spear_thrust_up.prompt: a Roman soldier seen from behind and below, thrusting a long spear steeply upward toward the crucified figure high against a dark storm sky, the moment of Zechariah's word arriving, vertical, 1st-century Judea

zechariah_night_scroll.prompt: an aged prophet standing on a flat rooftop at night, face lifted to a sky of stars, a rolled scroll held loosely at his side, moonlit ancient Judean city below, vertical, 1st-millennium-BC

mourners_only_son.prompt: a huddle of Judean mourners in rough cloaks at the foot of the cross at Golgotha, men and women weeping as they gaze up toward the crucified Christ above them, dim darkened afternoon light, low angle, vertical, 1st-century Judea

john_watching.prompt: a close shot of a young bearded disciple at Golgotha, his grief-stricken face lifted upward, one hand gripping the cloak at his chest, far behind him the crucified Christ hangs on his cross with head bowed against a plain dusky sky, morning light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

blood_water_wood.prompt: the crucified Christ on the cross, a Roman soldier's long spear thrust upward from below, the iron spearhead sunk deep into the side of his chest, the wooden shaft slanting down toward the ground, a stream of dark blood and clear water running from the wound down his skin, a plain cloth loincloth at his waist, dim darkened afternoon light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

grace_poured_sky.prompt: warm golden light pouring down like a waterfall from a single break in heavy dark clouds onto the small stone city below, the pouring is the subject, vertical, ancient Judea

look_up_faces.prompt: three different upturned 1st-century faces close together in half-light, eyes lifted toward a warm light above, tears catching the light, hope breaking on the faces, vertical

face_on_cross.prompt: a close portrait of the crucified Christ from the shoulders up, his thorn-crowned head lifted, eyes open toward heaven, the rough wooden beam behind his head, dim failing light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

golgotha_hill_wide.prompt: a wide view of three crosses standing on the low rocky rise of Golgotha outside the walls of Jerusalem, the crosses short rough wooden posts, the crucified men stripped to plain loincloths with their feet hanging just above the bystanders' heads, the centre cross bearing the crucified Christ, his bare dark hair against the open sky, a crucified thief stripped to a loincloth on each cross beside him, small mourners standing close below, low stone houses with plain flat earthen roofs beyond the wall, the sky a smooth deep black at midday, the hill and city lying dim in deep shadow, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

seamless_robe_lots.prompt: four Roman soldiers kneeling and standing around a long ankle-length tunic of finely woven ivory linen held up spread between them, the weave tight and costly with a soft sheen, one smooth unbroken piece from the shoulders down to the hem, a plain round neck opening, beside them a flat stone with small pebble lots scattered across it, bright morning light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

soldiers_gambling.prompt: four Roman soldiers kneeling in a circle on stony ground casting small lots for a folded seamless robe, above and behind them the crucified Christ hangs on his cross, morning light, low angle, vertical, 1st-century Judea

us_under_cross_shadow.prompt: two bowed figures kneeling small in the dust at dawn, the long shadow of a single cross falling across them and stretching up the ground, heads down and hands clasped, soft low golden light, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

animate.base: A finished inked graphic-novel comic panel — flat printed art with bold black ink outlines, cel-flat color and cross-hatching. Animate it as {move}. The drawing itself never moves, redraws, repaints, breathes or changes; the ink lines and flat colors stay exactly as printed; only the camera moves. No hard cuts, no dissolves, no morphing, no subject motion, no limbs moving, no new lines drawn. INVENT NOTHING: show ONLY what is already inked in this exact panel. Keep the subject whole in frame.
